Hi Michael / Karla —

Quick one: would you be open to leaving a short 1-3 sentence review of Redwood on G2? We’re updating our briefs and it helps other teams evaluate the same way you did.

If yes, here are three fulfillment options — tell me which you prefer and we’ll handle it quickly:
- $50 Amazon e-gift card (emailed)
- $50 donation to a charity of your choice (we’ll provide receipt)
- Redwood swag pack (hoodie + stickers, shipped)

I’ve attached a two-page draft case study (clearsync-case-draft-v2.pdf) and a one-click review link (g2-review-instructions.html) to make this as painless as possible. A 30-second template you can copy:
"We use Redwood Inference for low-latency LLM inference across our stack. Integration was straightforward and the team helped tune costs — we saw a 35% reduction in token cost post-deploy."

Can you confirm by EOD next Wednesday (Oct 6)? If you prefer, we can accept a quick rating-only submission. Thanks again for considering this — it’s very appreciated by our product and customer marketing teams.

Best,
